_comment: Default gate modes. Override per machine in ~/.jj-agentic-os/gates.json or env JJ_GATE_<NAME>. Promotion model: dryrun until measured FP < 2%, then enforce (see guardrail-forge skill). gate-protection and security-gate ship enforcing because they are safety-critical, not tunable. Since ADR-0027, security-gate/test-gate/i18n-complete each name ONE concern spanning two enforcement points - a fast per-edit check (PreToolUse/PostToolUse) and a full, Stop-level aggregate check - and this file is the only place either point reads its mode from; machine-local settings.json hooks read nothing here and are deprecated.
